theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 12 群

items.colloc: decide on a strategy 決定策略 | decide on a date 選定日期
items.distinct: decide to do 決定做某事 | settle on 最終選定
ex: Management needs to decide on the new budget.
管理層需要決定新的預算。
Have you decided on a venue for the event?
你們決定好活動場地了嗎？
They are yet to decide on the candidates.
他們尚未決定人選。

items.colloc: select a delivery option 選擇配送選項 | standard delivery option 標準配送選項
items.distinct: shipping method 運送方式 | pickup option 自取選項
ex: Please select your preferred delivery option.
請選擇您偏好的配送選項。
The delivery option you chose is unavailable.
您選擇的配送選項目前無法使用。
We offer a flexible delivery option for clients.
我們為客戶提供靈活的配送選項。

items.colloc: draw up a contract 起草合約 | need to draw up 必須起草
items.distinct: sign an agreement 簽署合約 | review an agreement 審閱合約
ex: The legal team will draw up a new agreement.
法律團隊將會起草一份新合約。
Let us draw up a new agreement tomorrow.
讓我們明天起草一份新合約。
It is time to draw up a new agreement.
現在是起草新合約的時候了。

items.colloc: drive off quickly 迅速開走 | drive off the lot 將車開離場地
items.distinct: drive away 駛離 | pull over 靠邊停車
ex: The courier had to drive off immediately.
快遞員必須立刻開車離開。
She watched the client drive off in his car.
她看著客戶開車離開。
After the meeting, he decided to drive off.
會議結束後，他決定開車離開。

items.colloc: local dry cleaner 當地乾洗店 | drop off at dry cleaner 送到乾洗店
items.distinct: laundry service 洗滌服務 | tailor 裁縫師
ex: I need to visit the dry cleaner today.
我今天需要去一趟乾洗店。
Is there a reliable dry cleaner nearby?
附近有可靠的乾洗店嗎？
The suit was sent to the dry cleaner.
西裝已經送到乾洗店了。

items.colloc: duty free shop 免稅店 | buy duty free items 購買免稅商品
items.distinct: tax-exempt 免稅的（稅務）| tax-free 免稅的（稅制）
ex: We stopped at the duty free store briefly.
我們在免稅商店稍作停留。
Are these goods considered duty free?
這些商品算是免稅的嗎？
Many travelers buy gifts at duty free.
許多旅客在免稅店購買禮物。

items.colloc: renewable energy source 再生能源 | alternative energy source 替代能源
items.distinct: power supply 電源供應 | fuel source 燃料來源
ex: The company is seeking a sustainable energy source.
公司正在尋找永續的能源來源。
Solar power is a popular energy source.
太陽能是一種受歡迎的能源來源。
We must diversify our energy source options.
我們必須使能源來源選項多元化。

items.colloc: enter into a contract 簽訂合約 | enter into negotiations 進行談判
items.distinct: participate in 參加 | start 啟動
ex: The firm decided to enter into a partnership.
該公司決定建立合作夥伴關係。
We are ready to enter into negotiations now.
我們現在準備好開始談判了。
They entered into a new agreement yesterday.
他們昨天簽訂了一份新合約。

items.colloc: even now I recall 即使現在我仍記得 | even now it remains 至今依然
items.distinct: even though 儘管 | right now 現在
ex: Even now, the issue remains unresolved.
即使到了現在，這個問題仍未解決。
I remember his advice even now.
即使在現在，我仍記得他的建議。
Even now, the market is still volatile.
即使在現在，市場依然不穩定。

items.colloc: even though it was raining 雖然在下雨 | even though he tried 儘管他試過
items.distinct: even if 即使（假設性）| although 雖然
ex: We finished the task even though it was hard.
儘管過程艱難，我們還是完成了任務。
Even though sales were low, profits grew.
儘管銷售額很低，利潤卻成長了。
He attended the meeting even though he was ill.
儘管生病了，他還是參加了會議。

items.colloc: favorable exchange rate 有利的匯率 | current exchange rate 現行匯率
items.distinct: interest rate 利率 | inflation rate 通膨率
ex: The exchange rate has fluctuated this month.
這個月匯率波動很大。
Check the current exchange rate before booking.
預訂前請確認現行匯率。
A strong dollar affects the exchange rate.
強勢美元會影響匯率。

items.colloc: no extra charge 無額外費用 | incur an extra charge 產生額外費用
items.distinct: hidden fee 隱藏費用 | service charge 服務費
ex: There is no extra charge for early check-in.
提早辦理入住無額外費用。
The service incurs an extra charge.
這項服務會產生額外費用。
Did you notice an extra charge on the bill?
你有注意到帳單上的額外費用嗎？

items.colloc: face to face meeting 面對面會議 | speak face to face 面對面交談
items.distinct: in person 親自 | video conference 視訊會議
ex: We should discuss this issue face to face.
我們應該面對面討論這個問題。
A face to face interview is required.
需要進行面對面的面試。
They met face to face to settle disputes.
他們面對面會談以解決爭端。

items.colloc: far from home 離家很遠 | far from perfect 一點也不完美
items.distinct: away from 離開 | by no means 絕非
ex: The office is far from the train station.
辦公室距離火車站很遠。
His performance was far from satisfactory.
他的表現一點也不令人滿意。
We are far from reaching our final goals.
我們距離達成最終目標還很遠。

items.colloc: trigger the fire alarm 觸發火災警報 | test the fire alarm 測試警報器
items.distinct: smoke detector 煙霧偵測器 | emergency exit 緊急出口
ex: The fire alarm rang during the conference.
會議進行中火災警報器響了。
Please ensure the fire alarm is operational.
請確保火災警報器運作正常。
We had a fire alarm drill today.
我們今天進行了火災警報演習。

items.colloc: first aid kit 急救箱 | first aid training 急救訓練
items.distinct: medical care 醫療護理 | emergency response 緊急應變
ex: Staff should know basic first aid skills.
員工應具備基本的急救技能。
The office has a complete first aid kit.
辦公室內有完整的急救箱。
He took a course on first aid.
他參加了一門急救課程。

items.colloc: make it a first priority 列為首要任務 | top priority 最高優先級
items.distinct: main goal 主要目標 | primary objective 主要目的
ex: Customer satisfaction is our first priority.
客戶滿意度是我們的首要任務。
Safety remains our first priority on site.
工地安全仍是我們的首要任務。
His first priority is to finish the report.
他的首要任務是完成報告。

items.colloc: sell at a fixed price 以固定價格出售 | fixed price contract 固定價格合約
items.distinct: market price 市場價格 | negotiable price 可議價
ex: The service is offered at a fixed price.
這項服務以固定價格提供。
All items in the shop have a fixed price.
店內所有商品皆為定價。
They signed a fixed price project agreement.
他們簽署了一份固定價格的專案合約。

items.pos: phr. 樓層經理；賣場經理
items.colloc: store floor manager 門市樓層經理 | speak to the floor manager 與樓層經理談
items.distinct: general manager 總經理 | assistant manager 副理
ex: You can ask the floor manager for help.
您可以尋求樓層經理的協助。
The floor manager oversees daily operations.
樓層經理負責監督日常營運。
Our floor manager is available for questions.
我們的樓層經理可以回答問題。

items.colloc: beautiful flower arrangement 美麗的花藝 | decorate with flower arrangement 用花藝裝飾
items.distinct: floral design 花卉設計 | bouquet 花束
ex: The lobby features a lovely flower arrangement.
大廳擺放了一盆美麗的花藝。
She signed up for a flower arrangement class.
她報名參加了花藝設計課程。
The flower arrangement brightened up the office.
這盆花藝讓辦公室增色不少。
